consigna: Three separate recordings, one per day, two to three minutes each, isolating two skills each from weeks 14 to 21. Notes yes, script no.
requisitos: Recording 1: giving constructive feedback (week 19) + precise words instead of overused ones (week 14)
Recording 2: agreeing and disagreeing (week 20) + reduced relative clauses (week 16)
Recording 3: comparing and contrasting (week 21) + past perfect for narrative order (week 17)
No recording longer than three minutes
Four advanced phrasal verbs spread across the three (week 15)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Recording 1: give feedback on someone's plan without a single *very*, *good* or *nice*.
*Wed (10 min).* Recording 2: disagree with a claim about travel, using two reduced relatives.
*Fri (10 min).* Recording 3: compare two ways of doing something, saying what had already happened before you chose.
autochequeo: Did feedback stay on behaviour, not character?
Were the reduced clauses correct, or did I drop a needed pronoun?
Did the past perfect make the order clear?
Which recording did I restart most often?
promptCorreccion: These are three separate short productions with two skills each. (1) For each, say whether both skills are present and well done. (2) Tell me which skill was weakest across all three. (3) Give me one sentence combining a reduced relative and a comparison. Correct nothing else. ---
